quests.title: Through the Flames
text: Vesna hears you lit a portal and hands over her old field journal with one rule: never sleep down there. Step through and survive your first ten minutes in the Nether.

lines: You lit a portal? Take my journal. Never sleep down there.
tasks.title: Take Vesna's field journal
Step through into the Nether

lines: Ten minutes. Don't sleep. Don't wander far.

tasks.title: Survive your first ten minutes in the Nether

quests.title: Forward Camp
text: Wall in your portal with blast-proof stone, and add a chest, a crafting table and a lit waystone so you always have a way home.

tasks.title: Wall in the portal and set up camp
Light the waystone so you always have a way home

quests.title: The Long Halls
text: Vesna's journal sketches a fortress nothing like the old maps. Find one of the rebuilt Nether fortresses and walk its great halls to the central keep.

tasks.title: Find a rebuilt Nether fortress and walk its great halls

quests.title: Rods for the Eyes
text: Every locator eye in the pack starts with blaze powder. Bring back blaze rods from the fortress spawners, without dying to the fireballs.

tasks.title: Fight the fortress's blazes for their rods
Bring back blaze rods for the eyes

quests.title: Skulls on the Wall
text: Wither skeletons patrol the fortress bridges. Vesna wants three of their skulls for something she won't name yet. Hunt them with a Looting blade.

tasks.title: Hunt the wither skeletons on the fortress bridges
Bring Vesna three skulls

quests.title: The Wart Garden
text: Someone tends a nether wart farm out in the wastes, and nobody knows who. Harvest from it, start your own soul-sand patch at camp, and brew three potions of fire resistance.

tasks.title: Find the wart garden tended by nobody
Harvest warts from the garden
Start your own soul-sand patch at camp
Brew three potions of fire resistance

quests.title: Golden Manners
text: Wear gold and barter with piglins until they've given you an ender pearl, obsidian and string. Vesna bets you'll be robbed at least once.

tasks.title: Wear gold so the piglins will trade
Barter for an ender pearl
Barter for obsidian
Barter for string

quests.title: The Lost Trader
text: A piglin with a merchant's pack has strayed from his camp and the hoglins are closing in. Keep him alive back to the piglin camp, where his chief owes you a favour.

encounter.name: Stray Trader
lines: Hoglins! My pack! Take me home, please!

tasks.title: Walk the stray trader home to the piglin camp

quests.title: The Outstation Ledger
text: The chief sends you with a sack of gold to the piglin outstation near the bastions. Deliver it, and find the ledger hidden there proving the brutes are skimming.

tasks.title: Carry the chief's sack of gold
Deliver the gold to the outstation

search.found: A ledger with two sets of figures.

tasks.title: Find the ledger proving the brutes are skimming

quests.title: Quiet Feet in the Bastion
text: The ledger names a bastion's treasure room. Get in, lift the gilded blackstone and a banner from the vault, and get out without the brutes ever turning on you.

lines: Quiet feet. If a brute lands a blow, you're seen.

tasks.title: Creep in to the treasure room without the brutes noticing

search.found: Gilded blackstone and a snout banner.

tasks.title: Lift the gilded haul from the vault

quests.title: The Lava Dock
text: A harbour on a lava sea, with moorings and cranes and no sailors. Read the harbourmaster's last log.

search.found: A scorched log, last entry smudged.

tasks.title: Read the harbourmaster's last log

quests.title: Strider Crossing
text: The harbourmaster's log mentions a route across the lava ocean. Saddle a strider and cross the lava inside four minutes.

tasks.title: Take a saddle for a strider
Take a fungus on a stick to steer it

lines: Four minutes across the lava. Ride!

tasks.title: Cross the lava ocean on a strider in four minutes

quests.title: The Keep at the Edge
text: A Nether keep sits near the fortress roads, held by blaze-guarded skeletons. Clear its walls and claim the keep's chest.

tasks.title: Clear the keep's walls of its garrison

search.found: The keep's strongbox, heavy with gold.

tasks.title: Claim the keep's chest

quests.title: Four Watchtowers
text: Skeleton towers and camps watch over every biome. Reach a tower or camp in the crimson forest, the warped forest, the soul valleys and the wastes.

tasks.title: Reach a tower in the crimson forest
Reach a tower in the warped forest
Reach a camp in the soul valley
Reach a camp in the wastes

quests.title: From the Fortress Tower
text: Climb a fortress tower and look out from its top. Mark down any fortress, bastion or skull on the horizon in Vesna's journal.

tasks.title: Climb a fortress tower
Bring a camera to mark the horizon
Photograph a fortress on the horizon

quests.title: The Mega Fortress
text: One of the mega fortresses dwarfs even the rebuilt halls. Fight through its towers to the treasure at the top.

tasks.title: Fight through the mega fortress's towers

search.found: A treasure chest at the top, banner-hung.

tasks.title: Claim the treasure at the top

quests.title: Bridges of Ash
text: Ancient bridges span the lava lakes. Cross three of them and note who built them. The stonework doesn't match any fortress.

tasks.title: Cross the first lava-lake bridge
Cross the second lava-lake bridge
Cross the third lava-lake bridge

quests.title: The Giant's Skull
text: A skull the size of a house lies half-buried in the wastes, with a second one in the sand. Find both, then work out from the carvings which way the giant was facing when it fell.

tasks.title: Find the second skull half-buried in the sand

search.found: Carvings inside the skull show a direction.

tasks.title: Read the carvings inside the first skull

rewards.name: Giant's Tooth
lore: From a skull the size of a house.

quests.title: The Giant's Sword
text: The carvings point to a crimson forest where a colossal sword stands buried to the hilt. Climb it and recover what's lodged at the guard.

tasks.title: Find the colossal sword in the crimson forest
Take a Relic from the Guard

rewards.name: The Giant's Edge
lore: From a sword buried to the hilt.

quests.title: The Ghost Train
text: A train sits on rails to nowhere in the Nether. Its spectral conductor wants the scattered cargo back in the wagons before it can 'depart'.

encounter.name: Spectral Conductor
lines: All aboard... cargo scattered... can't depart...

tasks.title: Meet the train's spectral conductor

item.name: Scattered Cargo
item.tooltip: Put it back in the wagons

tasks.title: Take Scattered Cargo

quests.title: Who Lives Here?
text: Small houses stand in the Nether, furnished and empty. Search two of them and piece together, from the notes left inside, what happened to the family.

tasks.title: Find the second empty house, its table still set

search.found: A note, left on a table in a hurry.

tasks.title: Search the first empty house for the notes the family left

quests.title: Under the Warped Dome
text: A glass dome shelters a warped garden and a pool full of warped toads. Gather shroomlights and twisting vines, and catch a warped toad.

tasks.title: Find the warped dome
Gather shroomlights from the garden
Gather twisting vines from the garden
Catch sight of a warped toad in the pool

quests.title: The Copper Tower
text: A copper tower in a realm without rain. Restore its oxidised lightning rods at the top and the vault door at the base opens.

tasks.title: Find the copper tower
Bring new lightning rods
Replace the oxidised rods at the top
Open the vault at the base

quests.title: Arena of Ash
text: In one of the Nether arenas, survive three waves of blazes, wither skeletons and magma cubes for five minutes. Win in the dragon arena and Vesna buys the drinks.

tasks.title: Enter the Nether arena

lines: Three waves. Five minutes. Don't leave the sand.

tasks.title: Survive the arena's waves for five minutes

quests.title: Offerings at the Shrines
text: Small shrines dot the wastes, some still smoking. Leave a gold ingot at a shrine and at a smoking shrine, and see what the realm gives back.

tasks.title: Find a small shrine
Leave a gold ingot at the shrine
Find a smoking shrine
Leave a gold ingot at the smoking shrine

quests.title: Wishing in Fire
text: A well in the Nether, full of lava instead of water. Fish out the coins at its bottom with a fire-resistant hand.

tasks.title: Fish the coins out of the lava well

quests.title: The Soul Valley Graves
text: A graveyard in the soul sand valley is circled by soul vultures. Find it, and take a soul heart from one of the vultures.

tasks.title: Find the soul valley's graveyard
Bring down the vultures circling the graves
Take a Soul Heart

quests.title: Mosquito Season
text: Crimson mosquitoes are draining the piglins' hoglins. Swat ten and bring a mosquito proboscis to the camp chief.

tasks.title: Swat the mosquitoes draining the piglins' hoglins
Bring a proboscis to the camp chief

quests.title: A Survey of Hell
text: Vesna's journal has blank pages for every biome she never saw. Stand in each of them and fill the survey.

tasks.title: Stand in the crimson forest
Stand in the warped forest
Stand in the basalt deltas
Stand in the soul sand valley
Stand in the visceral heap
Stand in the withered abyss
Stand in the crystalline chasm
Stand in the undergrowth
Stand in the erupting inferno

quests.title: Uncharted Regions
text: Rumours of glowing meadows and redstone pits. Visit the infernal holt, the glistering meadow, the mycotoxic undergrowth, the blackstone basin and the redstone abyss, and fill Vesna's journal.

tasks.title: Stand in the infernal holt
Stand in the glistering meadow
Stand in the mycotoxic undergrowth
Stand in the blackstone basin
Stand in the redstone abyss

quests.title: The Stranded Vintner
text: A winemaker who followed a rumour through a ruined portal is stranded in the crimson forest. He'll teach you Nether winemaking if you gather crimson and warped grape seeds for him.

encounter.name: Stranded Vintner
lines: Stranded since the rumour! Bring me crimson and warped grape seeds.

tasks.title: Find the vintner stuck in the crimson forest
Gather crimson grape seeds for the vintner
Gather warped grape seeds for the vintner

quests.title: A Vineyard in Hell
text: Plant crimson and warped grapes at your forward camp and harvest a crate of each, then build an apple press and fermentation barrel from Nether wood.

tasks.title: Plant crimson and warped grapes at your camp
Harvest a crate of crimson grapes
Harvest a crate of warped grapes
Build a press from Nether wood
Build a fermentation barrel

quests.title: Netherite Nectar
text: Ferment Ghastly Grenache, Blazewine Pinot and the vintner's prize Netherite Nectar, and deliver a bottle of each to Vesna in Reece, who has waited thirty years for a decent drink.

tasks.title: Ferment Ghastly Grenache
Ferment Blazewine Pinot
Ferment the vintner's prize Netherite Nectar

lines: Thirty years. Finally a decent drink.
Ghastly, blaze, netherite. You've done it.
tasks.title: Deliver a bottle of each to Vesna

quests.title: Deep Debris
text: Down at the bottom of the Nether, mine eight ancient debris. Vesna explains the trick with beds and tells you never to tell her how it went.

tasks.title: Dig down to the bottom of the Nether
Mine eight ancient debris

quests.title: The Burning Citadel
text: Fire that walks, and shields that circle it: a citadel in the wastes is held by something Vesna only calls 'the crowned flame'. Look at it from a safe distance.

tasks.title: Watch the crowned flame from a safe distance

quests.title: Small Places, Sharp Teeth
text: You've stumbled on a small Nether dungeon. Clear its spawner before it floods the passage.

tasks.title: Clear the dungeon's spawner of its skeletons

quests.title: The Devil's Rest
text: A horned statue squats over the lava, and people say it grants a wish to anyone who answers its riddle. The answer, the carvings hint, is an eye that sees nothing.

tasks.title: Offer the answer to the statue's riddle

quests.title: The Soul Forge
text: An anvil the size of a hall, ringing in the soul sand valley. Look but don't knock: whatever works the forge is not for now. Vesna will remember the way.

lines: Look. Don't knock. Don't get hit.

tasks.title: Creep close enough to look, and leave unseen

quests.title: The Arena of Embers
text: In the deepest wastes, a sealed arena burns with blue fire. Listen at its doors. Even Vesna won't go nearer.

lines: Listen at the doors. Don't get hit.

tasks.title: Creep to the sealed doors and listen

quests.title: The Crimson Donjon
text: Deep in a crimson forest stands a donjon, and near the bastions a piglin hamlet. Raid the donjon's tower, then trade at the hamlet with what you took.

tasks.title: Find the donjon deep in the crimson forest
Raid the donjon's tower

search.found: Gold and plunder from the donjon's keep.

tasks.title: Take the donjon's plunder to trade
Take the plunder to the piglin hamlet and trade

quests.title: The Monstrous Eye
text: The strongholds have woken. Craft the Monstrous Eye from netherite scrap and an eye of ender, and bring it to Vesna so she can confirm it points at the forge you found.

tasks.title: Gather netherite scrap for the eye
Gather an eye of ender for the eye
Craft the Monstrous Eye

lines: That points at the forge you found. Good.
tasks.title: Show Vesna the eye pointing at the forge

quests.title: The Flame Eye
text: Craft the Flame Eye and hand Vesna her journal back, filled in. She writes the last page herself: the arena is waiting, when the story is.

tasks.title: Craft the Flame Eye

lines: My journal, filled in. I'll write the last page.
The arena waits for the story.
tasks.title: Hand Vesna her journal back, filled in
